SQL statements that insert the sample data provided in Project 1.
Both in a single script named database_implementation.sql.
Queries that retrieve data from each non-associative table individually.

At least one query returns just the first N results.
At least one query uses a selection control function.
All in a single script named single_table.sql.
A query on an associative table and two other related tables, with INNER JOIN connecting all three.
A query on two or more tables using LEFT OUTER JOIN.

A query with a derived table built with the WITH statement.

todos.title: Merge the Project 1 schema and data into database_implementation.sql
todos.detail: Sources already exist: project1/source/physical_model/crossfade_schema.sql (10 tables with PK, FK, UNIQUE and CHECK) and crossfade_data.sql (401 rows). Both load cleanly on MySQL 8.0.46 (tested Oct 26). Generate the merged script from build_ddl.py, not by hand, and use the version with CHECK constraints, not the Workbench copy.

todos.title: Purpose comment before every CREATE TABLE and INSERT
todos.detail: Take the text from the requirements analysis entity descriptions so each table is justified by the business plan.

todos.title: artist: roster profile with tenure and payout
todos.detail: Single-row functions: DATEDIFF for days since joining, CONCAT/UPPER for the display line, ROUND(payout_rate * 1000, 2) for payout per 1,000 qualifying plays.

todos.title: track: newest releases in the catalogue
todos.detail: ORDER BY release_date DESC with LIMIT N, duration shown as mm:ss. This is the 'new uploads' shelf the business plan says is as findable as a hit.

todos.title: genre: reference list with a description fallback
todos.detail: IFNULL on the optional description. A 10-row lookup table risks looking trivial (G3), so give it a business reason, e.g. the label set every probability distribution is spread over.

todos.title: listener: accounts by plan tier
todos.detail: COUNT, MIN(signup_date) and average tenure, GROUP BY plan_tier. This is the subscriber mix behind revenue.

todos.title: scoring_model: deployed model leaderboard
todos.detail: Rank model versions by holdout_accuracy and compare concat vs gated fusion. This shows which model a new station should default to.

todos.title: station: classify each ambiguity window
todos.detail: CASE on (maximum_ambiguity - minimum_ambiguity) gives narrow, mid or wide. This is how adventurous each listener's station is.

todos.title: track_score: ambiguity summary per scoring model
todos.detail: AVG(posterior_entropy), MAX(model_divergence) and COUNT per model_id. Included so every table other than the two pure link tables gets its own query.

todos.title: play: royalty and completion ledger
todos.detail: SUM(royalty_amount), completion rate, and saved vs skipped counts via IF/CASE, per track or month. Included so every table other than the two pure link tables gets its own query.

todos.title: Assemble single_table.sql and check coverage
todos.detail: One query per non-associative table, 8 in all: artist, track, genre, listener, scoring_model, station, track_score, play. Requirements (a) to (e) must each appear at least once.

todos.title: INNER JOIN: each station's genre recipe
todos.detail: station INNER JOIN station_blend INNER JOIN genre, ordered by weight. Station Blend is a pure link table: two foreign keys and a weight. Alternative: track_score + genre_probability + genre.

todos.title: LEFT OUTER JOIN: catalogue with no plays yet
todos.detail: track LEFT JOIN play (with artist). Finds tracks never streamed, which is the artist-exposure gap. The sample has 4. Alternatives: scoring_model LEFT JOIN track_score (1 unused model), listener LEFT JOIN station (1 listener with no station).

todos.title: Set operation: tracks saved but never skipped
todos.detail: Saved EXCEPT skipped. EXCEPT needs MySQL 8.0.31 or later. If the grader's version is unknown, use a UNION form instead (e.g. tracks surfaced by a station UNION tracks played without one).

todos.title: Subquery with a multi-row operator
todos.detail: IN, ANY, ALL or EXISTS over a multi-row subquery. Example: tracks whose posterior entropy is above ALL scores in another genre, or listeners who played any track IN a given station's blend.

todos.title: WITH: artist royalty totals against the platform mean
todos.detail: A CTE sums royalty_amount per artist; the outer query compares each artist with the average and ranks them.

todos.title: Assemble multiple_table.sql
todos.detail: The five queries in order, each with its purpose comment.

todos.title: Function fn_royalty(track_id, seconds_played)
todos.detail: Returns the artist's payout_rate if 30 or more seconds were played, otherwise 0. This is integrity rule I7 from the requirements analysis.

todos.title: Procedure sp_record_play(...)
todos.detail: Inserts one play, derives completed (seconds_played = duration) and royalty_amount through fn_royalty, so the stored values cannot drift.

todos.title: Procedure sp_station_queue(station_id, n)
todos.detail: Returns the top N tracks matching the station's genre blend and ambiguity window, scored by the station's model. This is the core product feature. Alternative: sp_artist_statement(artist_id, from, to).

todos.title: Assemble routines.sql
todos.detail: DELIMITER blocks, DETERMINISTIC or READS SQL DATA declared on functions, and a short demo CALL or SELECT for each routine.

todos.title: Purpose comment on every statement, query and routine
todos.detail: Each comment says which business question it answers, not just what the SQL does.

todos.title: Review pass for trivial or generic queries
todos.detail: No bare SELECT * and no query that would fit any database. Each one uses something specific to CROSSFADE.

todos.title: Test harness: run all four scripts on a fresh MySQL 8
todos.detail: Runs implementation, single-table, multiple-table, then routines. Fails on any error or empty result set. Prints progress per script.

todos.title: Build project02_info579_group_1.zip
todos.detail: Built from project2/deliverables/ only, with the four .sql files at the top level, as in Project 1's build_submission.py.

todos.title: Confirm the Dropbox and upload
todos.detail: The brief says to upload to 'the assignment of project 1 Dropbox', which is probably a copy-paste error. Check D2L for a Project 2 Dropbox before submitting.

todos.title: Split the work with Nidhi and set internal dates
todos.detail: Leave at least two days before Nov 8 for the harness run and the review pass.

deliverables.what: CREATE TABLE for all 10 tables and INSERT for the 401 sample rows.
Five queries: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, set operation, subquery, WITH.
The four scripts above, top level, uploaded to D2L.

feedback: The only deduction in Project 1 was the conceptual model (9/10: many-to-many relationships not drawn). Project 2 has no conceptual-model deliverable, so nothing carries over. The schema and sample data are used as graded.
